title: Zombie Outbreak: 30 Days Locked Inside a Gas Station

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: It's 3:07 a.m. You're alone on the night shift at a highway gas station.
lines.tts: [calm, low] It's three oh seven A M. You're alone on the night shift at a highway gas station.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Then the door chime rings... and whatever just walked in is not here for gas.
lines.tts: [tense, slow] Then the door chime rings... [pause] and whatever just walked in... is not here for gas.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: You slam the lockdown button. Steel shutters crash down.
lines.tts: [urgent] You slam the lockdown button. Steel shutters crash down.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Day one. Twenty-nine to go.
lines.tts: [quiet, ominous] Day one. Twenty-nine to go.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: You have one small store, one steel shutter, and thousands of gallons of fuel under your feet that every survivor in this county is about to want.
lines.tts: [measured] You have one small store... one steel shutter... and thousands of gallons of fuel under your feet, that every survivor in this county is about to want.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: To reach Day 30, you'll have to solve five problems. And one of them nearly kills you on Day 19.
lines.tts: [low, foreboding] To reach day thirty, you'll have to solve five problems. And one of them... nearly kills you on day nineteen.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Day one. The adrenaline wears off around sunrise, and your hands start shaking.
lines.tts: [quiet] Day one. The adrenaline wears off around sunrise... and your hands start shaking.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Problem one: you don't actually know what you have. So before anything clever, you count.
lines.tts: [calm, focused] Problem one: you don't actually know what you have. So before anything clever... you count.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Six cases of bottled water. Four hundred bags of chips. Two hot dog rollers. One first aid kit. And a coffee machine that won't save your life, but might save your mind.
lines.tts: [matter-of-fact] Six cases of bottled water. Four hundred bags of chips. Two hot dog rollers. One first aid kit. [wry] And a coffee machine that won't save your life... but might save your mind.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Water is the real clock. FEMA says plan on one gallon per person, per day.
lines.tts: [serious] Water is the real clock. FEMA says plan on one gallon per person, per day.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Six cases is about nineteen gallons. Nineteen days. Remember that number.
lines.tts: [slow, pointed] Six cases is about nineteen gallons. Nineteen days. [pause] Remember that number.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Then you notice the second problem. The sign outside still glows: OPEN 24/7. In a dead town, that sign is a dinner bell.
lines.tts: [tense] Then you notice the second problem. The sign outside still glows. Open, twenty-four seven. In a dead town... that sign is a dinner bell.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: You pull the breaker. The sign dies. And somewhere in the dark, something stops walking toward you.
lines.tts: [whispering] You pull the breaker. The sign dies. And somewhere in the dark... something stops walking toward you.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Then you drag every shelf you can lift against the back door. The shutter covers the front. Nothing covers the back.
lines.tts: [determined, low] Then you drag every shelf you can lift against the back door. The shutter covers the front. Nothing covers the back.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: New rule of the night shift: no lights, no noise, and nobody comes in.
lines.tts: [firm, low] New rule of the night shift. No lights. No noise. And nobody comes in.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Day three. At 2:14 in the afternoon, the hum stops.
lines.tts: [calm] Day three. At two fourteen in the afternoon... the hum stops.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: The fridges. The lights. The ice machine. The grid is gone, and it isn't coming back.
lines.tts: [ominous] The fridges. The lights. The ice machine. The grid is gone... and it isn't coming back.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Inside, it's suddenly so quiet you can hear your own heartbeat.
lines.tts: [whispering] Inside, it's suddenly so quiet... you can hear your own heartbeat.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Problem three: your food just started a countdown. Food safety officials say a closed fridge keeps food safe for about four hours. A full freezer, about forty-eight.
lines.tts: [focused] Problem three: your food just started a countdown. Food safety officials say a closed fridge keeps food safe for about four hours. A full freezer... about forty eight.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: So you eat in order. Hot dogs and milk first. Sandwiches next. Chips and canned food, last.
lines.tts: [matter-of-fact] So you eat in order. Hot dogs and milk first. Sandwiches next. Chips and canned food... last.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: On aisle three you find a camping lantern and forty-eight batteries. Light, but only the kind that never leaves the building.
lines.tts: [calm] On aisle three, you find a camping lantern... and forty eight batteries. Light. But only the kind that never leaves the building.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: And you find the strongest room in the building: the walk-in cooler behind the drink doors. Thick walls. One door. No windows.
lines.tts: [impressed, low] And you find the strongest room in the building. The walk in cooler, behind the drink doors. Thick walls. One door. No windows.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: You don't know it yet, but that room is going to save your life.
lines.tts: [quiet, foreboding] You don't know it yet... but that room is going to save your life.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: That night, you hear them for the first time. Not one. Dozens.
lines.tts: [whispering] That night, you hear them for the first time. Not one. [pause] Dozens.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Day seven. 4:40 a.m. A car alarm starts screaming in the parking lot.
lines.tts: [tense] Day seven. Four forty A M. A car alarm starts screaming in the parking lot.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: You didn't set it off. Something walked into it. And everything within a mile just heard the dinner bell again.
lines.tts: [tense, low] You didn't set it off. Something walked into it. And everything within a mile... just heard the dinner bell again.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: By sunrise, there are forty of them pressed against your shutter.
lines.tts: [slow, dread] By sunrise, there are forty of them... pressed against your shutter.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Forty bodies. Six thousand pounds of weight against one sheet of steel. The shutter bends. One bolt pops. Then another.
lines.tts: [tense, building] Forty bodies. Six thousand pounds of weight, against one sheet of steel. The shutter bends. One bolt pops. [pause] Then another.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: This is where most people make their first mistake. They panic. They make noise. They try to run.
lines.tts: [serious] This is where most people make their first mistake. They panic. They make noise. They try to run.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: You do the opposite. Shoes off. Lights off. You crawl behind the counter, and you don't move. For eleven hours.
lines.tts: [whispering, intense] You do the opposite. Shoes off. Lights off. You crawl behind the counter... and you don't move. For eleven hours.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Rule of the night shift: silence is the only weapon that never runs out.
lines.tts: [firm, low] Rule of the night shift. Silence is the only weapon that never runs out.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: By nightfall they drift away, one by one. And then, on the night of Day 12, someone knocks. Not a scratch. A knock. Three times.
lines.tts: [calm, then tense] By nightfall, they drift away, one by one. [pause] And then, on the night of day twelve... someone knocks. Not a scratch. A knock. [whispering] Three times.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Every highway gas station has a night window: a steel drawer for passing cigarettes to customers after midnight.
lines.tts: [measured] Every highway gas station has a night window. A steel drawer, for passing cigarettes to customers after midnight.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: The knock comes again. You crawl to the window, and you slide the drawer open one inch.
lines.tts: [whispering] The knock comes again. You crawl to the window... and you slide the drawer open... one inch.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Tonight, a voice comes through it. A woman. Trucker jacket. Hands up. 'Please. I'm not bitten.'
lines.tts: [tense] Tonight, a voice comes through it. A woman. Trucker jacket. Hands up. [desperate whisper] Please. I'm not bitten.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Her name is Dee. Her truck jackknifed a mile down the highway. And she has news.
lines.tts: [calm] Her name is Dee. Her truck jackknifed a mile down the highway. And she has news.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: The radio says the National Guard will run an evacuation point at the county stadium. Eighteen days from now. Six miles away.
lines.tts: [hopeful, careful] The radio says the National Guard will run an evacuation point at the county stadium. Eighteen days from now. Six miles away.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Problem four isn't zombies. It's people. Open the door, and you get a partner... or someone who takes everything you have.
lines.tts: [serious, tense] Problem four isn't zombies. It's people. Open the door, and you get a partner... or someone who takes everything you have.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: What would you do? Think about it. Because you don't open the door.
lines.tts: [low, direct] What would you do? [pause] Think about it. Because you don't open the door.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: You slide two bottles of water through the drawer instead. She nods... and walks back into the rain.
lines.tts: [soft] You slide two bottles of water through the drawer instead. She nods... and walks back into the rain.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: You'll see her again. And next time, she won't be alone.
lines.tts: [ominous] You'll see her again. And next time... she won't be alone.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Day fifteen. Boredom is its own kind of danger. So you give your brain a job. You watch them.
lines.tts: [calm] Day fifteen. Boredom is its own kind of danger. So you give your brain a job. [pause] You watch them.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Through a crack in the shutter, with a notebook from the register, you write down everything they do.
lines.tts: [quiet] Through a crack in the shutter, with a notebook from the register... you write down everything they do.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: They don't see well in the dark. They follow sound for miles. And every evening at six, about twenty of them drift down the highway like a tide.
lines.tts: [low, observant] They don't see well in the dark. They follow sound for miles. And every evening at six, about twenty of them drift down the highway... like a tide.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Patterns are survival. If you know when they come, you know when you can move.
lines.tts: [calm, confident] Patterns are survival. If you know when they come... you know when you can move.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: And you learn one more thing. The loudest sound always wins. Remember that, too.
lines.tts: [slow, pointed] And you learn one more thing. The loudest sound always wins. [pause] Remember that, too.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Day nineteen. Remember that number? The last bottle is empty.
lines.tts: [quiet, tense] Day nineteen. Remember that number? [pause] The last bottle is empty.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: But you didn't skip the boring part of survival. FEMA lists a hidden water source in almost every building: the water heater.
lines.tts: [confident] But you didn't skip the boring part of survival. FEMA lists a hidden water source in almost every building. The water heater.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Forty gallons, sitting in the back room. You open the drain valve. Clean water. Weeks more. You almost laugh.
lines.tts: [relieved] Forty gallons, sitting in the back room. You open the drain valve. Clean water. Weeks more. [soft laugh] You almost laugh.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: And that's the mistake. To reach the valve, you dragged the shelves away from the back door. You never put them back.
lines.tts: [dark, slow] And that's the mistake. To reach the valve, you dragged the shelves away from the back door. [pause] You never put them back.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: 3 a.m. The back door clicks open. The latch was broken all along.
lines.tts: [whispering] Three A M. The back door clicks open. [pause] The latch was broken all along.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: There's one of them inside. Between you and everything you own.
lines.tts: [tense] There's one of them inside. Between you... and everything you own.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: You run for the strongest room you have. The walk-in cooler. You pull the door shut and hold it.
lines.tts: [urgent] You run for the strongest room you have. The walk in cooler. You pull the door shut... and hold it.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Now you're sealed in the dark, your breath turning to fog, listening to it scratch at the door.
lines.tts: [whispering] Now you're sealed in the dark... your breath turning to fog... listening to it scratch at the door.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: On your belt is the cashier's handset. It's wired to the speakers outside, the ones that say 'pump four is ready.'
lines.tts: [tense, thinking] On your belt is the cashier's handset. It's wired to the speakers outside. The ones that say... pump four is ready.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: You press the button, and you bang it against the wall.
lines.tts: [determined] You press the button... and you bang it against the wall.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: It turns. It follows the sound, out the back door, into the rain. You sprint, slam the door, and bury it under every shelf you own.
lines.tts: [fast, intense] It turns. It follows the sound. Out the back door, into the rain. You sprint, slam the door... and bury it under every shelf you own.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: You survived your mistake. But you just told the whole county exactly where you are.
lines.tts: [slow, ominous] You survived your mistake. But you just told the whole county... exactly where you are.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Day twenty-four. Headlights.
lines.tts: [tense] Day twenty four. [pause] Headlights.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: A pickup truck rolls in. Three men. Empty gas cans. And in the passenger seat... Dee.
lines.tts: [low] A pickup truck rolls in. Three men. Empty gas cans. And in the passenger seat... [pause] Dee.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Problem five: the pumps are dead without power, and they think you know how to turn them on.
lines.tts: [serious] Problem five. The pumps are dead without power... and they think you know how to turn them on.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: They pound on the shutter. 'Open up, and nobody gets hurt.'
lines.tts: [tense] They pound on the shutter. [shouting, distant] Open up, and nobody gets hurt!

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: One of them jams a crowbar under the shutter. Metal screams. You watch the gap grow. Two inches. Four.
lines.tts: [tense, fast] One of them jams a crowbar under the shutter. Metal screams. You watch the gap grow. Two inches. Four.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: You don't answer. Rule of the night shift: nobody comes in.
lines.tts: [cold, calm] You don't answer. Rule of the night shift. Nobody comes in.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: And their noise does what noise always does. Forty shapes walk out of the trees, toward the loudest thing in the parking lot.
lines.tts: [building tension] And their noise does what noise always does. Forty shapes walk out of the trees... toward the loudest thing in the parking lot.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Engines roar. Tires scream. And they're gone.
lines.tts: [fast] Engines roar. Tires scream. And they're gone.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Dee looks back at your store through the rain. You'll never know if she was their prisoner... or their guide.
lines.tts: [quiet, haunting] Dee looks back at your store through the rain. You'll never know if she was their prisoner... or their guide.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Day thirty. You scratch the last mark into the shutter. Thirty lines. Thirty mornings you were never supposed to see.
lines.tts: [quiet, emotional] Day thirty. You scratch the last mark into the shutter. Thirty lines. Thirty mornings you were never supposed to see.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: You counted before you acted. You killed the light. You stayed silent. You found the hidden water. And you never opened the door.
lines.tts: [steady, proud] You counted before you acted. You killed the light. You stayed silent. You found the hidden water. And you never opened the door.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: The evacuation is tomorrow. Six miles of highway, on foot, with everything you can carry.
lines.tts: [determined] The evacuation is tomorrow. Six miles of highway. On foot. With everything you can carry.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Before you go, you leave a note on the counter for whoever comes next. Count. Stay dark. Stay quiet. Don't open the door.
lines.tts: [soft, steady] Before you go, you leave a note on the counter, for whoever comes next. Count. Stay dark. Stay quiet. Don't open the door.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: You're packing your bag when, at exactly 3:07 a.m., the lights flicker on.
lines.tts: [tense, slow] You're packing your bag when, at exactly three oh seven A M... the lights flicker on.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Every one of them. The sign outside glows again: OPEN 24/7. And the door chime rings.
lines.tts: [whispering, dread] Every one of them. The sign outside glows again. Open, twenty-four seven. [pause] And the door chime rings.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Somebody turned the power back on. And somebody knows you're still in here.
lines.tts: [low, ominous] Somebody turned the power back on. And somebody knows you're still in here.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Would you have opened the window for Dee? Tell me in the comments. And subscribe, because Day 31 starts right now.
lines.tts: [direct, calm] Would you have opened the window for Dee? Tell me in the comments. And subscribe... because day thirty one starts right now.
